title: 440. Bomb Enemy

examples.explanation: A bomb on the middle of the first row sees two enemies downward and one to the side.
Walls block every column, so each empty cell sees exactly one enemy below it.

hints: Split each row and each column into wall-separated segments and count the enemies per segment.
An empty cell scores the sum of its row-segment count and its column-segment count.
Recomputing the blast per cell from scratch is O((mn)^2); the segment tables give O(mn).
